reviews.text: Great. Excellent app

Good. Good good
Yeet

Spiritually Comforting!. When I downloaded this app, I was looking for spiritual guidance. Lately, I have realised that people seem to not want to spend time with me like they used to. I would find myself lonely and missing the company of a friend.

I downloaded the app while looking for something to help me contact my Guardian Angel, and had high hopes for this app. 

Once I downloaded the app, it gave me instructions to close my eyes and think about my problems and it implied that I should ask the spirits what to do. After that, I tapped the screen and it showed me some beautiful cards. I scrolled through them and randomly chose a card. I got....

Ant! At first I thought, 'Wow, an ant?'. Discouraged, I flipped the card over to read the meaning. 

It told me that ants worked as a community, not alone. It said if you have ant it means you should try to go to community events and take care of those close to you. I was shocked. Even if this is a stroke of luck, this advice has benefited me as an individual. 

I'm not a very religious person, but this app (I know I'm probably overreacting) has made me feel more attached to a spirit close to me. 

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

- A comforted, pleased person.
